recreation_brief:
1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with a light gray background (#EAEAEA).
2. Add a thin dark red border (#8B0000) around the slide content area.
3. Add a centered title text box in the upper-middle area with the exact text: Adding non-Linearity to Perceptrons. Use a serif font, large size, bold, colored dark red (#C00000).
4. Add a second centered text box directly below the title with the exact text: (Activation Functions). Use the same serif font, slightly smaller than the title. Color the word "Activation" blue (#0000FF) and the rest "( Functions)" dark red (#C00000).
5. Insert a yellow circle (#FFF200) with a black outline in the top-right corner containing the number "16" in black text.
6. Add a solid black rectangle (#000000) spanning the full width along the bottom edge of the slide.
7. Ensure no bullets, charts, images, or other content are present.
